label: Bass behind, keys in front
why: Moving the big bass away lets the quieter keys come forward.

label: Solo the keys
why: Hear the keys on their own before you build the mix back up.

label: Push the drums up
why: The drums sit quietly in this song; bringing them close adds punch.

label: Dark, rumbling bass
why: Closing the filter on the bass turns it into a low rumble.

label: Echo on the keys
why: An echo on the keys fills the space between the notes.

label: Loop the second section
why: Looping one section turns the song into a groove you can shape.
